question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: Daishin and I met while we were both studying at UC Berkeley. With my computer science background and his design acumen, we began programming iphone apps and making a living off of that for some time. After a series of iphone apps and businesses, we learned that we worked really well together and both had the passion and resilience to eventually build a successful business.Prior to GOAT, we had launched a few projects one of them being a social dining app called Grubwithus. The idea behind the app was to break social norms and bring people together through food at a restaurant. The app gained a good amount of attention at first, but there were a lot of friction points with coordinating people, dates, food and restaurants, and we eventually realized it was a hard business to scale and decided to shut it down.In 2014 Daishin, a huge sneakerhead since he was a kid, unwittingly bought a fake pair of Jordans off of another platform. The process was difficult - Daishin had to look through many photos of the same shoes, then look to see how trustworthy a seller was, how much the price would be with shipping and when he would receive them by. There was no standardization. When the shoes arrived, he realized they were fake and we both understood that the fake sneaker industry was a big threat. We knew there was a need for a platform to regulate the system and there wasn’t a solid tool out there to do so. We created GOAT to bring trust and safety to the sneaker market.

Mass produced shirts were meant to accommodate a wide variety of body types with one standard size, and different brands have different sizing standards, making shopping difficult--many men must shop in 4 - 5 different stores before finding a shirt that actually fits! By providing a home try on program and giving the ability to make custom fit adjustments to all of their apparel, Vastrm allows its customers to finally hone in on and find the perfect fit for their unique body types.

Tang came up with the idea for Vastrm, which is a Sanskrit word for cloth, when a customer told him he had purchased a perfect shirt in Italy and has never been able to find the same fit again. name: Function of Beauty
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA
long_description: We’re a customized beauty brand at the intersection of tech and beauty, setting out to democratize custom beauty and truly empower individuality. There’s no one size fits all with us.
one_liner: Customizable beauty for hair, skin, and body care products.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: Function of Beauty was created by beauty outsiders: two MIT grads and a chemist who believed that everyone deserves a custom product and should be empowered to create their own beauty journey. Engineer and MIT grad Zahir Dossa was trained to see problems as equations to be solved. But when he looked at the beauty industry, what he saw didn’t add up—real people were more than broad categories like “curls” or “dry,” so cookie-cutter solutions could never deliver transformational results. No wonder consumers never saw the results they were after. But making effective, customized products at scale was thought to be impossible.   Zahir teamed up with fellow MIT grad Josh Maciejewski and cosmetic chemist Hien Nguyen, combining their expertise in supply chain, sustainability, and data science to create something revolutionary in the beauty industry. They imagined enabling every consumer to create their own product based on a totally customized set of variables, made to order with bespoke craftsmanship and care. They imagined an algorithm-based approach that would let them constantly iterate and improve every formula. The most important variable at the center of their equation was the consumer, who—for the first time—could be honored with formulas as one-of-a-kind as they were.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer: We built a pioneering production facility and algorithm that allowed customers to co-create perfect, freshly crafted hair care formulas.  We focus on select, targeted, high-performing ingredients, expertly combined to work for optimal efficacy. We deliver freshly formulated, customized hair care right to customers, minimizing waste and ensuring you get everything they need  — and nothing they don’t.After building a successful DTC business, we set out to become an omni-channel pioneer and bring customization to the brick and mortar environment. In 2020, we designed and introduced a new concept and behavior for consumers - giving them options to mix their own custom shampoo and conditioner at home.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: At Function of Beauty, our mission is to truly empower individuality and we are the first brand to deliver on this promise by offering a fully personalized response to the vast diversity of hair and skin goals that women and men have. There is no one size fits all product, and we believe customization is the ultimate response to consuming more sustainably by having the perfect product made just for you. Customization is a challenging task that most beauty brands have not been able to figure out. We developed a unique technology and manufacturing capability which allows us to create custom formulas at scale.  We saw an opportunity to make a difference.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: We often get the question about how big is big for customization. We believe we are at the beginning of a fundamental evolution of customer behavior. Customization is  the future of beauty. It is a sustainable response to the consumer evolution and changing complexity of their beauty needs.  Today, nearly everyone can have access to custom formulas for their unique hair, skin and body needs. We want to continue to democratize access to custom beauty products over the next few years.

name: Lygg
long_description: Up to 90% of skin aging is caused by UV light from the sun. name: Dressd
long_description:
Dressd is AirBnb for clothes; a P2P clothing rental marketplace. Unlike Rent the Runway, we don’t handle any inventory or deal with cleaning the items. Our initial target market is sorority girls who can have up to 3-4 events per week that they need a new outfit/dress for. One of our core theses is that this idea couldn’t have existed at scale until now because resale apps like Depop & Poshmark paved the way for a P2P model to work after familiarizing users with the process of taking pictures of items, shipping, etc. 

Advantages to our P2P model

- Entrepreneur-led
    - Similar to Depop, most of our growth will be spearheaded by a group of “top renters”
- More variety in inventory
    - Existing rental companies like Rent the Runway own all the inventory so they're limited to the brands they buy/partner with. Since we're P2P, our users can rent any item or brand that's in someone else's closet
- Better margins
    - we don’t touch any inventory or deal with the cleaning of any items
    - Unlike Rent the Runway, we don’t handle any inventory or the cleaning of items. This means people renting out their clothing on Dressd are responsible for shipping things out & returning them in good condition

launches.title: Retrofit — a vintage marketplace curated by AI 🛍️
launches.tagline: The hottest vintage inventory handpicked for you
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We’re [Sandra](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sandra-lifshits/) and [Maddy](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mjyip/), cofounders of [Retrofit](https://www.retrofit.shop/)! 👋

**TL;DR: **[**Retrofit**](https://www.retrofit.shop/)** is a vintage marketplace powered by AI. We use AI agents to curate and personalize in-demand, trending inventory. We analyze social media trends, sales data, and your personal style to find the best vintage pieces for you—so you don’t have to dig through thousands of listings to find vintage gems.**

<https://youtu.be/-tw1LSSL91k>

# 🚨**The Problem:**

The secondhand apparel market is booming — it’s estimated at $43 billion in 2024 in the US and expected to grow to over $125 billion by 2034. However the existing players have not kept up with this demand.

Shoppers want to buy more vintage online, but many don’t because the selection is **overwhelming**, inventory is **low quality**, and online secondhand shopping **feels like work**. Shopping secondhand often means sifting through garbage inventory and being an expert to find that incredible one-of-a-kind vintage gem. But this can finally change… 

# ⚒️**The Solution:**

We are building a new curated vintage marketplace powered by AI.

Our AI agents sift through hundreds of thousands of listings from vintage sellers across the country, to find the **best inventory.** We rely on sales and trends data to determine what type of items people are looking for and then add only the best inventory based on factors such as brand, price, materials, and condition. 

Our inventory is **personalized to your style and needs**. Give us your style pinterest board or other inspo photos and we will personalize your recommendations. If we don’t have exactly what you are looking for right now, you can tell us what you are looking for and our AI agents will find it for you. 

# **🙌 Our Asks:**

✅ If you love vintage or are vintage-curious, **check out our inventory at **[**Retrofit**](https://www.retrofit.shop/)**.** If you are looking for something specific, submit a request! 

✅If you know someone who loves vintage, **help us spread the word**.

✅ **Follow us** on [Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/company/106068920/), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/retrofit.ai), and [Tiktok](https://www.tiktok.com/@retrofit.ai).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88315&key=user_uploads/1336189/3749b259-e0ea-4076-a908-b642dd629af2)

# **🤝The Team**

Sandra gained **hands-on experience** by volunteering at several vintage stores in New York to understand their operations and vintage shopper’s behaviors. Her background is as a product leader at two different ecommerce startups. She met Maddy while getting her **MBA at Stanford**. Maddy brings her expertise in **computer vision** from her time at **Google** and **Stanford CS**. She led two computer vision patents during her time at Google.

Thank you for your support! You can always reach us at [sandra@retrofit.shop](mailto:sandra@retrofit.shop)
